maria: kicking off a small bake for inference-api -> ramp 5% -> 20% in eu-west, change window OK 22:00-23:00 UTC :hourglass:
sam: +1, I'll monitor SLOs and watch the canary dashboards
deploy-bot: Promotion started: inference-api@v2.3.1 5% -> 20% (region=eu-west)
anya: seeing a tiny error blip on the canary; rolling 5m window error rate 0.6% -> 1.8% (just noticed)
lee: dash link: https://grafana/redwood/d/infra/inference-canary?panel=errors
maria: pausing the ramp. hold at 5%. pinning v2.3.1 to eu routes until we triage
deploy-bot: Rollout paused by user maria
sam: can we grab a quick stacktrace sampler and ingestion logs? runbook: https://confluence/redwood/runbooks/inference-rollback
anya: paste log snippet: "grpc: deadline exceeded" x12 over 3m, some TLS timeouts
maria: ops-bot, sanity-check runbook steps
ops-bot: Runbook summary: 1) warm caches 2) re-run prefetch job 3) if errors persist -> rollback to v2.3.0. Links: /runbooks/inference
maria: agree with runbook. try warming cache + prefetch first. rollback is last resort
lee: prepping rollback plan and helm commands, standby ETA ~6m
sam: I'll start the prefetch job and watch traces
sam: prefetch job started (job id: 39821) :rocket:
deploy-bot: Prefetch job submitted: id=39821, target=eu-west
anya: re-checking canary after prefetch kickoff; will report in 5m
oncall-bot: paging sam @here
sam: on it, watching errors and p99 latency
maria: decision: hold. do not increase traffic until error rate stays <=1.0% for 15m. if >1.0% sustained -> rollback
anya: ack
lee: rollback command (if needed):
```
helm rollback inference-api --namespace prod --to-revision 27
kubectl rollout status deploy/inference-api -n prod
```
sam: updating release notes: note about v2.3.1 small TLS timeout workaround and monitoring hooks
maria: tagging docs and infra: @lee @sam please coordinate the rollback checklist so support can run it quickly if we need to
lee: will post checklist in ops channel and attach the exec commands
deploy-bot: current snapshot: latency +11ms, errors +1.2pct (canary)
maria: thanks. I'll reconvene after 15m and call final stop/go. no further traffic shifts until then :lock:
sam: standing by
anya: monitoring alerts configured, will escalate if trend continues
maria: (after 15m) holding decision: errors trending down to 0.9% after warm cache. keep pinned, resume ramp only after stable 30m window or on consensus
sam: noted, resuming passive monitoring
lee: rollback artifacts pre-staged in case of flip
maria: final: HOLD -> no ramp to 20% for now. will reopen if metrics clear. closing thread for now, will file short postmortem if we hit rollback
